title: 第1章  风起荒墟
slug: 凡人从拔刀三十万次开始
content_zh:
“小叔，只要你不赶我们娘俩走……我什么都依你………”
耳畔传来苦苦的哀求声，陈时安的意识迅速恢复清醒，缓缓睁开眼睛。
只见，衣衫朴素却难掩丽质风韵的妇人正紧紧地抓着老柳树下的磨盘。
而自己，正拦腰将妇人抱住，双手按在最不该按的地方。
胳膊上，还挂着一个身形瘦弱、美人坯子开始成型且泪眼汪汪的小女孩。
这个畜生是我？
陈时安连忙将罪恶的双手松开，恍惚了好一阵。
我没凉透？穿越了！
前世的他，退役边疆战士，为救一对陌生母女，被失控的车子撞飞…………
醒来的时候，却到了这里，荒墟。
一处流民汇聚，被世俗遗弃，弱肉强食，妖吃人、人也吃人的不法之地。
认清穿越的事实，陈时安快速冷静下来，消化、融合原主的记忆：
这方世界，既有世俗的王朝争霸，也有力可开山截江的武者。
原主同样也叫陈时安，吊儿郎当、文不成武不就，除了一副好看皮囊便一无是处的惫懒货。
若不是有个好哥哥，以他的条件，在荒墟肯定活不到十八岁。
可惜，他的哥哥在十天前死了，留下寡妻孤女。
哥哥一死，没了收入来源，坐吃山空，陈时安便想着把嫂子和侄女给卖了，换几两银子。
不过，明着卖是不行的，因为嫂子和侄女乃是荒墟风起城寨的居民。
风起城寨有规矩，拥有了城寨居民的身份，就受城寨保护，不得买卖。
于是，原主便计划着，将嫂子和侄女赶出陈家，先剥夺她们城寨居民的身份。

而买主，此刻就在离着陈家不远的地方，只等着母女俩被赶出………
…………
眼前的母女就是嫂子苏晴柔和侄女陈甜甜。
原主游手好闲，手无缚鸡之力，本想将苏晴柔拉扯出家门，不成想，拽了老半天，竟是没能将后者拽出院子。
最后更是一个重心不稳，一头撞在院子里的老柳树上，直接蒙圈。
等到清醒过来，身体已经换了主人。
陈时安颇有些无奈。
上一世，他为救一对陌生母女奋不顾身，原主却为了自己苟活，要卖自己的侄女和嫂子。
同一个名字，天壤之别的性子。
原主，虽然你不是个东西，但我既然用了你的身体，作为回报，别的先我不吹，把你的纨绔名声洗一洗还是没有问题的…………
苏晴柔看到陈时安怔怔地发呆，以为他在犹豫，连忙说道：“小叔，念在你大哥的份上，不要赶我们走，好么？
我们娘俩若是被赶出了陈家，便不受城寨保护，只有死路一条。”
“我知道，你一直馋我的身子………时常偷看我沐浴………只要你不赶我们，我什么都答应你……………。”
听到这里，陈时安的脸皮烧得火辣辣的痛。
他尴尬地咳嗽了一声，“嫂子，你肯定是眼花了，我陈时安乃是正人君子，平日里见到穿着不检点的女子都脸红，如何会行那不齿之事…………
我什么时候说过要赶你们走，我是看你因为大哥的死太过伤心，想让你和甜甜出去走走，放松一下心情。”
苏晴柔眨了眨眼睛，眼神中带着大大的怀疑。
今年才十岁多点的陈甜甜快步来到母亲的身边，急声道：”母亲，千万不要相信他的话。
他就是一个骗子，嘴里没一句实话。
年年骗我压岁钱，说转天就还，一年又过了一年，从没见还过。”

陈时安恨不得找条地缝钻进去，清了清嗓子，“甜甜，咱俩可是血脉相连的叔侄，借就是借，说骗多伤感情。
你每年一文的压岁钱，三岁到十岁，一共才八文钱。
就这么点银钱，小叔怎么可能耍赖？你给我几天时间，我一定双倍还给你。”
他不是胡乱应承，而是真心要还银钱，更迫切地需要赚银子。
原主要卖嫂子买侄女，不单单需要银子度日，还得缴纳城建税。
风起城寨的居民，每半年需要缴纳一次城建税，说直白一些，就是保护费。
每半年，一人二两银子。
陈时安大哥在世的时候，因为是风起城寨城卫营的什长，陈家便无需缴纳城建税。
如今，大哥死了，立马就有人过来催讨，限期就是这个月底。
一人二两，他，加上苏晴柔和陈甜甜，那就是六两。
如果交不出城建税，就得被赶出风起城寨。没了城寨的保护，以陈时安此际单薄的体格，在盗匪横行、妖兽出没的荒墟里，估摸熬不过两天，就得被吃得不剩骨头渣子。
陈时安的大哥在风起城寨的城卫营混了二十多年，也有些积蓄，但他临死前，卧床养伤小半年，积蓄几乎全对付在汤药上。
再加上操办后事，如今，陈家已经掏不出几个铜板。
原主卖掉嫂子和侄女，既能得了卖身钱，又能省去四两银子的城建税，算是一举两得的好买卖……………
“又是双倍还。”
陈甜甜的小瘦脸上露出嘲讽表情，“这句话，你前前后后说了八年，何时兑现过？
再说了，花银子你倒是很在行，赚银子，你会么？”
陈时安不自觉红了脸，“这回一定兑现，最迟不超过这个月。”
“要我信你，除非老母猪上树。”陈甜甜轻哼。
苏晴柔连忙将女儿拉住，生怕她将陈时安惹恼，“小叔，你身边总要有个女人照顾，我洗衣做饭、耕种桑麻………，但凡女人能做的，我都能做……………，绝对不会成为你的累赘，还能补贴些许家用……………。”

看着眼前姿容俏丽但满脸凄苦的女人，陈时安心情复杂，既是怜悯，又有几分惭愧。
尽管犯下恶行的是原主，但因果得由他来承受。
“嫂嫂，什么累赘不累赘的，我们是一家人，大哥虽然不在了，你们还是陈家的人。”
“既然你不愿意出去散心，那便算了，我现在有事，得出去一趟。”
陈时安把话说完，便准备离开院子。
见状，苏晴柔的第一反应：陈时安在演戏、在使诈，肯定没安什么好心。
同在一个屋檐下生活了十几年，她对这个小叔的性子再清楚不过。
“小叔，你真不赶我们出陈家了？”苏晴柔小心翼翼地问道。
陈时安把手一挥，“哪有什么真不真的，我陈时安一口唾沫一口钉，撂下的话………………。”
说到这里，他没法往下说了。
原主连小孩子的压岁钱都骗，他的信誓旦旦可不值半块铜板。
于是，他止住话头，迈步向着门外走去。
信任这东西，一旦崩塌，再想建立，千难万难。
要让苏晴柔母女相信自己，任重而道远。
“小叔，你莫要再去赌了。你大哥已经不在，若是再欠下别人银钱，可没法还了…………。”
苏晴柔看到陈时安真要离去，急急出声。
“嫂嫂，我不是去赌，我出去办点事，用不了多久就会回来。”陈时安头也没回，迈过门槛，大踏步离去。
苏晴柔和陈甜甜的买主就在不远处等着，已经收了人家的定金，自然得先将这件事给摆平。
不然，麻烦不小。
“小叔最不值得信任，他肯定是去赌钱。”

荒墟弱肉强食，孩子相应早熟一些，陈甜甜拉住母亲的手，“母亲，我们赶紧走吧。
小叔即便不赶我们出陈家，可我们已经交不起城建税，他如今还跑去赌钱，我们迟早要被赶出风起城寨。
与其等到被赶，还不如自己主动走，也能多些准备。”
苏晴柔面色愁苦，“母亲何尝不知道这个理，但是，我们能去哪里。
若是没有城寨的庇护，我们母女便没有任何活路。
在荒墟，谁都在苟活，能多活一日便是一日……………。”
content_en:
"Brother-in-law, as long as you don't drive us away... I will do anything for you..."
A bitter plea came from his ears, and Chen Shi'an quickly regained consciousness and slowly opened his eyes.
I saw a woman in simple clothes but unable to hide her beauty and charm, tightly clutching the millstone under the old willow tree.
And he was hugging the woman around the waist, pressing his hands where they shouldn't be.
On the arm, there was also a thin little girl whose beauty was beginning to take shape and whose eyes were full of tears.
Is this beast me?
Chen Shi'an quickly released his sinful hands and was in a daze for a while.
Am I not cool enough? Time traveled!
In his previous life, he was a retired frontier soldier who was hit by an out-of-control car while trying to save a strange mother and daughter...
When I woke up, I arrived here, in the ruins.
A place where refugees gather, abandoned by the world, a lawless place where the jungle eats the strong, monsters eat people, and people eat people.
After recognizing the fact of time travel, Chen Shi'an quickly calmed down, digested and integrated the memory of the original owner:
In this world, there are not only secular dynasties competing for hegemony, but also powerful warriors who can conquer mountains and rivers.
The original owner is also named Chen Shi'an, a lazy guy who is careless, incompetent in literature and martial arts, and has nothing but good looks.
If he hadn't had a good brother, given his conditions, he would definitely not have survived to the age of eighteen in the ruins.
Unfortunately, his brother died ten days ago, leaving behind a widow and an orphan.
After his brother died and his source of income was gone, Chen Shi'an thought of selling his sister-in-law and niece for a few taels of silver.
However, it is not possible to sell it openly, because the sister-in-law and niece are residents of Huangxu Fengqi City Walled City.
There are rules in Fengqi Walled City. As a resident of the Walled City, you are protected by the Walled City and are not allowed to buy or sell.
Therefore, the original owner planned to drive his sister-in-law and niece out of the Chen family and first deprive them of their status as residents of the walled city.
The buyer, at the moment, is not far from the Chen family, just waiting for the mother and daughter to be kicked out...
…………
The mother and daughter in front of them are sister-in-law Su Qingrou and niece Chen Tiantian.
The original owner was idle and had no strength to restrain the chicken. He wanted to drag Su Qingrou out of the house, but to his surprise, after dragging for a long time, he was unable to drag the latter out of the yard.
In the end, his center of gravity became unstable and he hit the old willow tree in the yard, directly trapping him.
When I wake up, my body has changed its owner.
Chen Shi'an was quite helpless.
In his last life, he risked his life to save a strange mother and daughter, but the original owner had to sell his niece and sister-in-law to survive for himself.
Same name, completely different personalities.
Original owner, although you are not a thing, since I used your body, in return, I will not brag about anything else, but there is no problem in cleaning up your reputation as a playboy...
Su Qingrou saw Chen Shi'an in a daze and thought he was hesitating, so she quickly said: "Uncle, for the sake of your elder brother, don't drive us away, okay?
If our mother and I are driven out of the Chen family, we will no longer be protected by the walled city and will only die. "
"I know that you have been coveting my body... you often peek at me bathing... As long as you don't chase us away, I will promise you anything..."
Hearing this, Chen Shian's face burned with pain.
He coughed awkwardly, "Sister-in-law, you must be dazzled. I, Chen Shi'an, am a gentleman. I usually blush when I see a woman dressed immodestly. How could I do such a disgraceful thing...
When did I say that I would drive you away? I saw that you were too sad because of the death of your eldest brother, and I wanted you and Tiantian to go out for a walk and relax. "
Su Qingrou blinked her eyes, with great suspicion in her eyes.
Chen Tiantian, who was just over ten years old this year, quickly came to her mother's side and said urgently: "Mom, don't believe what he said.
He is a liar and never tells the truth.
They lied to me about New Year's money every year, saying they would pay it back the next day. Year after year passed, and I never saw it paid back.. "
Chen Shi'an wanted to find a crack in the ground to crawl in, and cleared his throat, "Tiantian, we are uncle and nephew connected by blood, borrowing is borrowing, lying will hurt your feelings.
Your annual New Year's money of one penny, from the age of three to ten, is only eight pence in total.
With just such a small amount of money, how could my uncle cheat? If you give me a few days, I will pay you back twice as much. "
He didn't just agree randomly, but he really wanted to repay the money, and even more urgently needed to make money.
The original owner wanted to sell his sister-in-law to buy his niece. Not only did he need money to live on, he also had to pay urban construction tax.
Residents of Fengqi Walled City need to pay urban construction tax every six months. To put it more bluntly, it is protection fee.
Every six months, two taels of silver per person.
When the eldest brother Chen Shi'an was alive, because he was the chief of the city guard camp in Fengqi City, the Chen family did not need to pay urban construction tax.
Now that the eldest brother is dead, someone will come immediately to demand payment, and the deadline is the end of this month.
Two taels per person, plus Su Qingrou and Chen Tiantian, that's six taels.
If you can't pay the city construction tax, you will be kicked out of Fengqi City. Without the protection of the walled city, with Chen Shi'an's frail physique at this time, in the ruins where bandits are rampant and monsters are infested, it is estimated that he will not be able to survive for two days before he will be eaten to the bone.
Chen Shi'an's eldest brother had been working in the city guard camp of Fengqi City for more than 20 years and had some savings. However, before his death, he stayed in bed to recuperate for half a year, and almost all of his savings were spent on decoctions.
Coupled with the funeral arrangements, the Chen family can no longer afford a few coins.
When the original owner sold his sister-in-law and niece, he not only got money for selling himself, but also saved four taels of urban construction tax. It was a good deal that killed two birds with one stone...
“Double payment again. "
Chen Tiantian's thin face showed a mocking expression, "You have been saying this for eight years, when have you ever fulfilled it?
Besides, you are very good at spending money. How about making money? "
Chen Shi'an blushed unconsciously, "I will definitely honor it this time, no later than this month. "
"I will believe you only if the old sow climbs a tree. "Chen Tiantian hummed.
Su Qingrou quickly held her daughter back, fearing that she would annoy Chen Shi'an, "Brother-in-law, there must always be a woman by your side to take care of you. I wash, cook, and cultivate mulberry and hemp... I can do anything a woman can do... and I will never be a burden to you, and I can also subsidize some household expenses..." "
Looking at the pretty but miserable woman in front of him, Chen Shi'an felt mixed emotions, feeling both pity and a bit ashamed.
Although it is the original owner who committed the evil deed, he must bear the consequences.
"Sister-in-law, there is no need to be a burden. We are a family. Even though the eldest brother is gone, you are still members of the Chen family. "
"Since you don't want to go out and relax, then forget it, I have something to do now and I have to go out. "
After Chen Shi'an finished speaking, he was ready to leave the yard.
Upon seeing this, Su Qingrou's first reaction was: Chen Shi'an was acting and cheating, and he definitely had no good intentions.
Having lived under the same roof for more than ten years, she knew very well the temperament of this brother-in-law.
"Uncle, are you really not going to kick us out of the Chen family? "Su Qingrou asked cautiously.
Chen Shi'an waved his hand, "There is nothing true or untrue. I, Chen Shi'an, spat and nailed the words I left behind... "
At this point, he couldn't go on.
The original owner even defrauded children of their New Year's money, and his vows were not worth half a copper.
So, he stopped talking and walked towards the door.
Once trust is broken, it is extremely difficult to establish it again.
There is a long way to go to make Su Qingrou and her daughter believe in them.
"Uncle, don't gamble anymore. Your eldest brother is no longer here. If you owe money to others again, you won't be able to pay it back... "
When Su Qingrou saw that Chen Shi'an was really leaving, she hurriedly spoke out.
“Sister-in-law, I’m not going to gamble, I’m going out to do some errands and I’ll be back soon. "Chen Shi'an didn't even look back., crossed the threshold, and strode away.
The buyers of Su Qingrou and Chen Tiantian were waiting not far away. They had already received their deposit, so naturally they had to settle the matter first.
Otherwise, there will be a lot of trouble.
"My uncle is the least trustworthy. He must be gambling."
In the wilderness, the weak eat the strong, so the child matures earlier. Chen Tiantian took her mother's hand and said, "Mom, let's go quickly.
Even if my uncle doesn't drive us out of the Chen family, we can no longer afford the city construction tax, and now he's still gambling. Sooner or later, we will be kicked out of Fengqi City Walled City.
Instead of waiting to be evicted, it is better to take the initiative and be more prepared. "
Su Qingrou looked sad, "Why don't mothers know this truth, but where can we go.
Without the protection of the walled city, we, mother and daughter, would have no way of survival.
In the ruins, everyone is struggling to survive, and one more day is just a day... "
